questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: I knew the school had a really good langauge program, and it was my goal to improve my lanuage skills.

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Overall, I had a really good time. However, there were still some unexpected challenges.

questions.question: How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: The school was very good at sending and responding to emails about necessary information.

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: Emails from the school and orientation for all exhange students.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
questions.answer: The school had an additional ensurance that was "mandatory" for all exchange students. However, the shcool informed students that if you already had an international ensurance, you did'nt have to pay it. This was not true for many exchange students. I think the school should have been more transparent and informative regarding this issue.

questions.question: How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing through my host institution

What should future exchange students know about living in on campus housing? *
questions.answer: The dorms are very different, and its not possible to choose. Some dorms did'nt have kitchens and others were not close to the school.

Additional comments:
questions.answer: Overall communication was good and the proces was smooth.

questions.question: Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: Most of it was done electronically through email or the schools platform. However, the school wanted a physical copy of a tuberculosis test. This information was delivered rather late, so it was difficult to get.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: You could text the school via email.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Check your email often and dont hesitate to ask.

questions.answer: It's difficult to say only one thing. To be honest just to be around other people with a different culture and perspectives were the thing I appreaciated the most.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer: Remember to check your emails. They also inform you about social activities. Remember to have fun also.

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: The langauge school is rather intensive, so you might not have as much time to go explore and do social activities as some of the other exchange students. But it's a really good course.

questions.answer: For me its rather personel. I've type 1 diabetes. And it was very diffcult to transport that much medicin into another country.
